name: interface-taste
description: Opinionated craft standards and implementation recipes for making web and desktop interfaces feel like flagship native software (inspired by OpenCode Desktop). Use when building or polishing UI motion, rolling or live-ticking numbers, shimmering status text, parallel spinners, collapsible sidebars, morphing composer or card surfaces, flyout menus, dark/light chrome, typography wrapping, or custom scrollbars - or when the user asks to give an interface great taste, native feel, or smooth micro-interactions. Not for screen architecture or task flows (ui-design), broad layout/colour scales (ui-design-playbook), or unsupervised multi-round polish loops (ui-hill-climb).
